description_expanded:
Experience Alys Beach in style on your next vacation in this three-bedroom, three and a half -bathroom courtyard home. You will enjoy features such as a first-floor primary suite with a luxurious ensuite bath. The private courtyard features a pool, built-in grill, covered deck and open patio for relaxing in the sun. Walking into the home, you find a fully-equipped kitchen and cozy dining room that leads to the living room, with a gas fireplace for those cooler evenings. The second floor offers two guest bedrooms with king-sized beds and private baths as well a forth bedroom with two queen-sized beds and a private bath. Located steps away from Raw and Juicy restaurant, a short walk to the beautiful Caliza Pool complex, North Charles Street leading directly to the beach, you’ll have everything at your fingertips. Parking is located in a courtyard at the rear of home with two designated spaces. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, the Silva Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
